title: Understanding the Hypothesis
text: The null hypothesis states that $$\theta_0$$ equals $$0$$. This means we are testing if the intercept of the model is zero.

title: Bootstrap Confidence Interval
text: A 95% confidence interval that includes $$0$$ suggests that there is not enough evidence to reject the null hypothesis that $$\theta_0$$ equals $$0$$.

title: Interpreting the Confidence Interval
text: If the confidence interval includes $$0$$, it does not necessarily mean the true value of $$\theta_0$$ is $$0$$. It means we cannot rule out $$0$$ as a possible value.

title: Evaluating the Statement
text: Based on the confidence interval interpretation, is the statement 'If the 95% confidence interval of $$\theta_0$$ from the bootstrapped samples includes $$0$$, then the true value of $$\theta_0$$ is 0' true or false?
